items.title: Dick Spottswood interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 13, 2023
items.q: what about Jack Teagarden, what about Jimmy Rodgers, what about Elvis Presley? Those people all had a right to sing the blues I think.

ctx.x: You wouldn’t have an Earl Bostic without Coleman Hawkins. So all of that music belongs together and I’ll just repeat what I said earlier that I think it’s easier and even that’s not easy to separate southern music or northern music with an area like rhythm & blues where things do tend to kind of overlap. But I think the north-south distinction is a more useful one that the black and white one. And that’s true of the blues too because if you’re talking about white blues singers, what about Jack Teagarden, what…
Well said. This has really been fascinating, and I appreciate your time. I wonder if you were to get up now after we’re done and go put on some music —
